Platforms: Windows
Emitted when a process that applied ForceASLR to a module detects an invalid execution attempt. This should only happen during an exploit, when the initial
ROP chain is designed to defeat ASLR.
In the case of a typical ALSR bypass attempt (trying to utilize code in a rebased image as part of a ROP chain), TargetAddress and ExceptionAddress will likely
be identical, as will ImageFileName and SourceFileName.
